name: Sticker Card
description: A full-bleed photo with a slightly tilted tone 'sticker' card (italic serif headline and a short caption), a white pill label top-left and a small call to action bottom-right.
photoTip: The sticker covers the bottom-left; keep faces in the top half. There is no wash on the photo, so pick one where the corners are calm.

tones.note: All six tones work; the sticker is the tone colour.

fields.label: Pill label
fields.hint: Optional short label top-left. Not for social handles.

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: Italic serif, one or two short lines.

fields.label: Caption
fields.hint: Optional, up to two short lines.
